    14  # First-Order Substructures

    16  This file defines substructures of first-order structures in a similar manner to the various

    19  ## Main Definitions
    20  
    21  - A `FirstOrder.Language.Substructure` is defined so that `L.Substructure M` is the type of all
    22      substructures of the `L`-structure `M`.
    23  - `FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure` is defined so that if `s : Set M`, `closure L s` is
    24      the least substructure of `M` containing `s`.
    25  - `FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.comap` is defined so that `s.comap f` is the preimage of the
    26      substructure `s` under the homomorphism `f`, as a substructure.
    27  - `FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.map` is defined so that `s.map f` is the image of the
    28      substructure `s` under the homomorphism `f`, as a substructure.
    29  - `FirstOrder.Language.Hom.range` is defined so that `f.range` is the range of the
    30      homomorphism `f`, as a substructure.
    31  - `FirstOrder.Language.Hom.domRestrict` and `FirstOrder.Language.Hom.codRestrict` restrict
    32      the domain and codomain respectively of first-order homomorphisms to substructures.
    33  - `FirstOrder.Language.Embedding.domRestrict` and `FirstOrder.Language.Embedding.codRestrict`
